_comment: Curated feed list for get_news_digest. THIS FILE IS THE QUALITY CONTROL: the summarizer only compresses what these feeds contain — it never web-searches, so a source not listed here cannot enter the digest. Live-read on every call (like lenses.md): edit + commit, no rebuild/restart needed. Add a feed by dropping a {source,url} into the right section. Verify a new URL returns RSS/Atom before adding (curl it; look for <rss/<feed/<?xml).

_omitted.anthropic.com/news: No public RSS/Atom as of 2026-06. Big Anthropic releases reliably surface via Hacker News + Simon Willison; revisit if a feed appears or if a one-off index scraper is ever justified.
_omitted.iea.org: No working RSS endpoint found 2026-06. Energy/grid thread is carried by Doomberg + G&R for now.

ai.title: AI / frontier
ai.note: The main course. Official model-maker sources first (least hype), then one or two curators. If you add aggregators, keep it to a couple — the curated list is the point, not breadth.

macro.title: Macro / finance / heterodox
macro.note: The Lyn Alden tier PLUS the prior-challenging voices (Wang, Pettis, Tooze) which are REQUIRED, not optional — a feed that only confirms your priors is the amplifying mirror in a nicer wrapper. Keep them in even when they annoy you.

feeds.note: quarterly; low-frequency, big signal. May be unreachable from the box — swap URL here if it stays dead.
REQUIRED prior-challenger. If this feed stays dead in the failed-feeds report, find a live Pettis URL and swap it here — do not just drop him.

industry.title: Industry awareness
industry.note: LIGHT on purpose — ambient awareness, NOT a canary/dashboard. Hard cap enforced in the fetcher. Resist the urge to grow this section; if it needs tending it has overgrown its brief.
